source: I can accept a delay if you explain the reason and the new timeline.
target: A delay can be accepted when its cause and revised timeline are clear. Do not leave others guessing.
references: A delay can be accepted when its cause and revised timeline are clear. Do not leave others guessing.
source_meaning: I can accept a delay if you explain the reason and the new timeline.

source: First-time user ko guide chahiye, obstacle course nahi.
target: A process should not demand experience from someone using it for the first time. Make the path clear.
references: A process should not demand experience from someone using it for the first time. Make the path clear.
source_meaning: We need to make the process simpler for someone doing it for the first time.

source: I want us to learn from the failure instead of hiding it.
target: Failure can teach us, if we examine it. Concealment only ensures that the lesson is lost.
references: Failure can teach us, if we examine it. Concealment only ensures that the lesson is lost.
source_meaning: I want us to learn from the failure instead of hiding it.

source: Estimate confirm nahi hua. Date promise karna abhi premature hai.
target: No date will be promised until the estimate is confirmed. Hope is not a schedule.
references: No date will be promised until the estimate is confirmed. Hope is not a schedule.
source_meaning: We cannot promise a date until the team confirms the estimate.

source: I need the freedom to question the plan without being labelled negative.
target: Questioning a plan is not negativity. It is how weaknesses are found before they become disasters.
references: Questioning a plan is not negativity. It is how weaknesses are found before they become disasters.
source_meaning: I need the freedom to question the plan without being labelled negative.

source: Incomplete data hai toh label karo. Guesswork ko certainty mat banao.
target: If the information is incomplete, say so plainly. A missing fact must not be disguised as certainty.
references: If the information is incomplete, say so plainly. A missing fact must not be disguised as certainty.
source_meaning: If the information is incomplete, we should say so clearly.

source: I will stand by you, but I won't lie for you.
target: I will stand beside you, but I will not become an instrument of your lies.
references: I will stand beside you, but I will not become an instrument of your lies.
source_meaning: I will stand by you, but I won't lie for you.

source: Facts ek side. Assumptions doosri. Mix karoge toh picture blur hogi.
target: Separate what is known from what is assumed. Confusing them is how poor decisions gain authority.
references: Separate what is known from what is assumed. Confusing them is how poor decisions gain authority.
source_meaning: Let's separate what we know from what we are assuming.

source: A good solution should still work when the original expert is unavailable.
target: A sound solution must endure even when its expert is absent. Dependence is a fragile foundation.
references: A sound solution must endure even when its expert is absent. Dependence is a fragile foundation.
source_meaning: A good solution should still work when the original expert is unavailable.

source: Preferred outcome alag hai. Fair outcome zyada important.
target: Fairness matters more than personal preference. The outcome need not favor me to be just.
references: Fairness matters more than personal preference. The outcome need not favor me to be just.
source_meaning: I want a fair outcome, even if it is not the outcome I hoped for.

source: Inspector aane tak original seal ko mat todna.
target: Keep the original seal intact until the inspector arrives. Do not destroy what must be verified.
references: Keep the original seal intact until the inspector arrives. Do not destroy what must be verified.
source_meaning: Keep the original seal intact until the inspector arrives.

source: If Leo is late again, start the meeting without him.
target: Leo is late again. Begin the meeting without him; the work cannot wait forever.
references: Leo is late again. Begin the meeting without him; the work cannot wait forever.
source_meaning: If Leo is late again, start the meeting without him.

source: Mujhe original file chahiye, screenshot nahi.
target: I need the original file, not an image of it. A copy of the appearance is not the source.
references: I need the original file, not an image of it. A copy of the appearance is not the source.
source_meaning: I need the original file, not a screenshot of it.

source: We have saved 18,000 rupees, but the repair will cost 22,000.
target: We saved eighteen thousand rupees, but the repair costs twenty-two thousand. The shortfall is four thousand.
references: We saved eighteen thousand rupees, but the repair costs twenty-two thousand. The shortfall is four thousand.
source_meaning: We have saved 18,000 rupees, but the repair will cost 22,000.

source: Spare medicine kisi aur ko mat dena.
target: Do not give the spare medicine to anyone else. It is not yours to redistribute.
references: Do not give the spare medicine to anyone else. It is not yours to redistribute.
source_meaning: Do not give the spare medicine to anyone else.

source: Once the guests arrive, please serve the food.
target: Serve the food once the guests arrive. The order of events matters.
references: Serve the food once the guests arrive. The order of events matters.
source_meaning: Once the guests arrive, please serve the food.

source: Engine ne woh awaaz phir ki toh main mechanic ko call karunga.
target: If the engine makes that noise again, I will call the mechanic. The warning will not be ignored.
references: If the engine makes that noise again, I will call the mechanic. The warning will not be ignored.
source_meaning: I will call the mechanic if the engine makes that noise again.

source: The blue folder belongs to Sana, while the green one is mine.
target: The blue folder belongs to Sana; the green one is mine. Keep ownership clear.
references: The blue folder belongs to Sana; the green one is mine. Keep ownership clear.
source_meaning: The blue folder belongs to Sana, while the green one is mine.

source: Main 2:20 wali train le sakta hoon, 2:05 wali nahi.
target: I can take the two-twenty train, not the two-oh-five. The earlier departure is beyond reach.
references: I can take the two-twenty train, not the two-oh-five. The earlier departure is beyond reach.
source_meaning: I can take the 2:20 train, but not the 2:05 one.

source: Please ask Farah before using her laptop.
target: Ask Farah before using her laptop. Permission must come before access.
references: Ask Farah before using her laptop. Permission must come before access.
source_meaning: Please ask Farah before using her laptop.

source: Water filter ka cartridge har chhe mahine mein badalna hota hai.
target: The water filter requires a new cartridge every six months. Maintenance delayed becomes failure invited.
references: The water filter requires a new cartridge every six months. Maintenance delayed becomes failure invited.
source_meaning: The water filter needs a new cartridge every six months.

source: I did not receive the parcel that was marked delivered yesterday.
target: I did not receive the parcel marked delivered yesterday. The record and reality do not agree.
references: I did not receive the parcel marked delivered yesterday. The record and reality do not agree.
source_meaning: I did not receive the parcel that was marked delivered yesterday.

source: Dono parents agree nahi karte toh school trip ka form submit nahi ho sakta.
target: Without agreement from both parents, the school trip form cannot be submitted. One approval is not enough.
references: Without agreement from both parents, the school trip form cannot be submitted. One approval is not enough.
source_meaning: Unless both parents agree, the school trip form cannot be submitted.

source: The technician will arrive between 11 am and noon.
target: The technician will arrive between eleven and noon. Be ready within that window.
references: The technician will arrive between eleven and noon. Be ready within that window.
source_meaning: The technician will arrive between 11 am and noon.

source: Galat document bhejne se behtar hai ek din wait kar loon.
target: I would rather wait one day than send the wrong document. Delay can be corrected; a careless error can spread.
references: I would rather wait one day than send the wrong document. Delay can be corrected; a careless error can spread.
source_meaning: I would rather wait one day than send the wrong document.
